audit.why: Early leans Yone (crit passive plus Q pressure before Viktor's combo exists), mid is a spacing skill fight, two-plus items decisively Viktor — matches packet chart and 50.44% WR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike structure sound (Q3 threat 3-5, level 6, first item flip, late teamfight).

Content mislabels ability slots: Gravity Field called (E) in spikes[0] and mid, 'Death Ray (W)' in mid (it is Hextech Ray, E slot), and Spirit Cleave called Yone's E in wants.you[0] (it is W; Soul Unbound is E). wants.foe[1] uses 'Death Ray'. Full chart was a blanket 'Yone' on all 7 rows against content/packet [Yone,Skill x5,Viktor]. Cooldowns field had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes.
audit.why: Kit file is the slot/name authority; content and packet charts already agree.
audit.corrected: Slots and names fixed, sides moved with rewritten whys, cooldowns numbered (Soul Unbound 22s->10s, R 120/100/80s), bleed bullets rewritten.

audit.why: Soul Unbound at 22s rank 1 is the punish window; Yone R 120s early.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: His crit-passive autos and Q pressure win the level-1 walk-up before your combo exists — concede melee range and farm.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: The trade evens once you can space his Q3 — the knock-up needs two stacks first, so sidestep the telegraphed third cast.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: A pure skill fight: your laser zoning trades evenly with his gap-close — hold Gravity Field for his Q3 or Soul Unbound.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Even jockeying over wave state and cooldowns — his Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1, so punish hard right after he spends it.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: His R commits him fully behind you, but your own R plus Gravity Field makes the soul-return path lethal — even on reads.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: Both spike on first item: his stacked trades briefly match your Luden's poke, so the duel stays a cooldown-reading tie.

edits.before: Yone
edits.after: Viktor

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two-plus items your poke, waveclear and AoE zone outscale his dash-in kit — he must commit R into your storm to touch you.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Gravity Field has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, 10s at max — his burst window; survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - His R is 120/100/80s: with it down his all-in threat drops a class. - Your W is 17s at rank 1 — it exists for his dash, not for poke.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Fire the laser from off-angle beyond his 450-range Q — through the wave, never down the lane's centre where his Q3 and R line up.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Gravity Field pre-placed on his dash path denies the Q3 knock-up; dropped after he is airborne on you, it saved nothing.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Yone wins by trading through Spirit Cleave's shield, stacking Q3 knock-ups, and cashing Soul Unbound bursts you didn't budget.

edits.before: Yone's real threat is his Q3 knock-up after two stacks plus E, so never let him hit you with the third Q while your Gravity Field (E) is down; he wants to Q-gap and W-shield the trade.
edits.after: Yone's real threat is his Q3 knock-up after two stacks plus E, so never let him hit you with the third Q while your Gravity Field (W) is down; he wants to Q-gap and W-shield the trade.

edits.before: From 3 onward it evens out into a skill fight: hold Gravity Field (E) for his Q3 or E gap-close rather than throwing it on cooldown, and Death Ray (W) his dash path to zone. Shove with empowered Q so he last-hits under tower, denying the stacks and windows he needs; if he R's you, walk out of the marked zone before the soul returns.
edits.after: From 3 onward it evens out into a skill fight: hold Gravity Field (W) for his Q3 or E gap-close rather than throwing it on cooldown, and Hextech Ray (E) his dash path to zone. Shove with the laser so he last-hits under tower, denying the stacks and windows he needs; if he R's you, walk out of the marked zone before the soul returns.

edits.before: Space so Yone's E (Spirit Cleave) and Q3 knock-up whiff into your Gravity Field
edits.after: Space so Yone's W (Spirit Cleave) and Q3 knock-up whiff into your Gravity Field

edits.before: Shove waves with your empowered Q so he's pinned last-hitting under tower
edits.after: Shove waves with your Hextech Ray so he's pinned last-hitting under tower

edits.before: Use his W shield and dashes to eat your Q augment and Death Ray for free
edits.after: Use his W shield and dashes to eat your Q augment and Hextech Ray for free
